v3.2_baseline.rationale: Baseline state with all v3.2 high-risk clauses unaddressed. Screen failure rate driven primarily by drug-naïve inclusion and narrow BMI band. Weekly visit schedule for 24 weeks creates investigator burden and extends site activation.

after_drug_naive_fix.rationale: Allowing stable metformin opens enrollment to the majority of newly-diagnosed T2DM patients. Screen failure rate drops sharply from 70% to 42%. Time to LSI shortens by 3 weeks. Estimated $0.6M in enrollment cost savings.

after_drug_naive_and_bmi_fixes.rationale: Widening BMI to ≤40 captures the dominant T2DM phenotype in US and Brazil. Combined with the metformin allowance, screen failure rate is now within typical Phase III range. Time to LSI shortens by 4 weeks total.

after_all_three_fixes.rationale: All three HIGH-risk clauses addressed. Biweekly visit schedule after Week 8 reduces investigator burden by 33%, freeing site capacity. Combined enrollment cost savings of $1.4M and 5-week reduction in time to last-subject-in.
